relationships.subject: PRMT6
relationships.evidence_quote: Levels of p-ERK1/2, a marker of neuronal hyperactivation, were significantly reduced in the ipsilateral L3/4 dorsal horn of SNI mice microinjected with LV-PRMT6 compared with those microinjected with LV-GFP

relationships.subject: EPZ020411
relationships.evidence_quote: EPZ020411 exacerbated the hypersensitivity response to mechanical stimuli induced by SNI.

key_findings: PRMT6 falls in DRG after nerve injury; its loss causes pain hypersensitivity while overexpression relieves SNI allodynia.
PRMT6 binds hnRNP-F (residues 319-388, independent of H3R2 methylation), suppressing hnRNP-F and preserving MOR.
